tasks.title: Reference semantics calibration
tasks.action: Run unit tests and scripts/run_transfer_formal_mechanics_reference.py; freeze only a REFERENCE_SEMANTICS_CALIBRATION receipt.

tasks.title: Finite relational mapping benchmark
tasks.action: Generate >=120 fresh small typed relational structures with exact hidden mappings/non-mappings and surface decoys; dispatch frozen arms; score with exhaustive oracle.

exact_study.note: supersedes nothing; the FM/FG R2 LLM-dispatch fm10 cell sat at ceiling (all five arms 1.000) and could not discriminate

tasks.title: Anti-unification/generalization benchmark
tasks.action: Generate >=120 symbolic generalization tasks and compare fixed lessons, semantic retrieval, applicable anti-unification/LGG parent, strongest formal parent, F0/static F2/full transfer discovery.

tasks.title: Formal Concept Analysis concept revision
tasks.action: Generate >=96 formal contexts with exact Galois closures plus hidden revision/counterexample cases; test specialize/split/merge/bridge/no-change and old-case retention.

tasks.title: Invariance/equivariance discovery
tasks.action: Generate >=120 finite transformation-action tasks with true, equivariant, false and regime-bounded invariants; test unseen transformations and false-invariance controls.

tasks.title: Functoriality and commuting diagrams
tasks.action: Generate >=96 finite-category tasks only where categorical semantics are valid; score identity/composition/diagram preservation and false equivalence.

tasks.title: Obstruction and counterexample discovery
tasks.action: Generate >=120 conjecture/transfer tasks with zero, one or multiple hidden obstructions; exact finite-model or proof witness must be found before claim acceptance.

exact_study.note: the FM/FG R2 LLM-dispatch fm60 cell was the campaign's floor study (all five arms identical at 32/120, 0.267) and could not discriminate; the exact study registers G0f's solvable half as a hard gate and plants a synthetic 0.267 floor table that must fail it

tasks.title: Prospective regime selector
tasks.action: Train selector only on designated development folds using pre-outcome features; compare held-out always-SIMPLE/F0/F2/ABSTAIN policies and resource Pareto frontier.

tasks.title: Naturalistic mathematics-science transfer
tasks.action: Prospectively freeze >=3 materially distinct domains including >=1 mathematical/formal and >=2 empirical sciences; use strongest native parents, formal witnesses and independent scientific adjudication.

tasks.title: Paper result import and contraction
tasks.action: Validate hashes/receipts, bind exact outcomes to P-A/P-B/P-C/flagship claim ledgers, retain parent wins/negative results, and apply issue #47 successor/contraction rules before manuscript result claims.

global_rules: Never mutate E20/E30 frozen endpoints with this successor programme.
No fixed mathematics or science lesson table is framework truth.
Formal witness does not establish empirical truth.
Empirical success does not establish a universal formal theorem.
Strongest applicable formal/scientific parent must execute.
All null, parent-win, simple-win, false-analogy, obstruction and CANNOT_CHECK results remain visible.
No automatic paper promotion from reference calibration.
